chapters.label: Live: the 2012 World Cup
chapters.text: The 2012 Futsal World Cup quarter-final. Russia score first against Spain. Then Carlos Ortiz comes on. He pokes the ball with his toe, past the keeper, into the far corner. One all!

chapters.label: Replay: the toe-poke
chapters.text: Watch again. A quick poke with the toe, and the keeper is beaten! His teammates rush to him. Spain win three two.

chapters.label: The long shot from the back
chapters.text: How does a fixo score from the back? Ortiz shoots from far away. The ball skids along the floor, under the keeper’s hands. Keep your shot low, so it skids past the keeper!
